title: Keto Egyptian Lamb Skillet
description: A flavorful and spicy keto lamb skillet with an Egyptian twist. Serve with a side of vegetables or a salad.

ingredients.name: Skillet-cooking oil
ingredients.notes: such as avocado oil or coconut oil

instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
6. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
7. Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
8. Return the lamb to the skillet and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 10-15 minutes.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
